summary: Add tradition-group preset picker to scope page
description:
The scope page (src/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx, nav-labelled Scope) renders 21 traditions as a flat one-at-a-time toggle list, which got tedious as the corpus grew. Add a preset picker above the tradition list that pre-selects texts in broad strokes.

Presets (curated slug-lists — corpus.traditions carries no era/region/family metadata, so grouping is editorial and lives in code), 3 axes / 10 chips, non-exclusive, members overlap freely:
- Era: Ancient / Medieval / Modern (Modern = print-era: renaissance_hermeticism, western_esoteric, finnic)
- Region: Western / Eastern / Near Eastern / Indigenous (egyptian in BOTH Near Eastern and Indigenous, per user)
- Current: Hermetic / Platonic / Abrahamic

Decisions (user, 2026-07-17): egyptian in both region groups; no single-member presets; carry all three axes.

Behavior: each chip is tri-state mirroring the tradition rows (check=all in scope, dash=partial, plain=off). Off/partial click pulls all member traditions into scope; full click removes them. Absolute set (not a flip) so overlapping presets stay predictable. Flows through existing setCatalog -> debounced autosave; no new save path. Members absent from the live corpus are filtered out and a zero-member preset drops its chip, so adding/removing a tradition later can't leave a dead button.

Implementation (already built on working tree):
- src/lib/scope-presets.ts — PRESET_AXES data + pure presetState / applyPreset helpers
- src/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx — import, applyPresetToCatalog handler, picker JSX above the rows
- src/__tests__/scope-presets.test.ts — 10 tests (state derivation, apply, integrity: every member slug is a real tradition hue key; no <2-member preset)

Done contract: tsc clean; scope-presets tests pass; /settings compiles and serves 200. Full click-through is behind Clerk auth (user to browser-verify layout).

resolution.note: Preset picker shipped: 3 axes / 10 chips above the tradition list, tri-state, absolute-set apply through existing autosave. tsc clean; 10 preset tests + 12 existing scope tests pass; /settings serves 200. Layout browser-verify pending (Clerk-gated).
